poses.label: Upright
poses.description: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart. Reach your arms forward for balance.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Bend your hips and knees together, with your heels planted and knees following your toes.

poses.label: Bottom
poses.description: Lower as far as you can control with your whole foot on the floor.

poses.label: Stand
poses.description: Push through both feet to stand tall again.

limitations: The illustration uses forward arms to match the ThoeneFit catalog cue.
